summary: Menu reorganization + Moduli e Attivazioni hub tested end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (SA modules list/history, CR free grant -> status active -> idempotent re-grant -> revoke (2nd revoke 400), toggle controlroom -> status false, access false, checkout 403, purchase row kept, re-enable restores; toggle planner -> access false, audit module_disabled, re-enable; 403 for org admin on all /platform/orgs/{id}/modules* routes; X-Org-Id spoof to another org -> 403; staff member -> /org/modules 403 but /org/modules/access 200; unauth 401). UI SA: sidebar groups in the expected order (planner, controlroom, organizzazione, account, marketing-admin, platform), no duplicate Event Planner/Control Room links, CR lock shown -> grant via OrgDetail ?tab=moduli -> lock gone after navigation -> revoke works, history table shows entries, planner toggle shows 'Disattivato dal Super Admin' + sidebar lock, re-enable OK. /marketing/admin shows fic-card + brevo-card, brevo-check-btn returns a toast ('BREVO_API_KEY non configurata', the env has no key), /piattaforma organizzazioni shows platform-integrations-moved and no fic/brevo cards. Org admin (new TEST_ org): groups planner/controlroom/organizzazione/account only, locks on all 3 modules, /organizzazione/moduli cards + Marketplace link (no toggles), /organizzazione/utenti table, /marketing/admin and /piattaforma redirect to /app, /profilo?tab=utenti redirects to /organizzazione/utenti, Profilo tabs = Account + Il mio abbonamento. /event-planner, /event-map, /control-room, /marketplace load. Mobile 390px drawer shows all groups and navigation closes the drawer. One gap: when the SA disables Event Planner/Event Map, the per-event activate/checkout endpoints still work (see below).

minor.issue: These endpoints do not check whether the SA has disabled the module (modules_disabled). activate() in addons.py:241 and checkout() in addons.py:326 never call _disabled(). For an org whose plan includes the product (included_free>0, e.g. TEST_EventMap Org planner 0/1), an admin can still activate an event while the module is disabled. This uses up the included slot. They can also start a Stripe checkout for a disabled module. Control Room already blocks this (checkout returns 403 when disabled). Not reproduced live, because doing so would have used up the TEST_EventMap Org included slot. On a trial TEST org the call returned 403 addon_required only because it had no included slots.

ui_bugs.component: EventPlanner page (/event-planner) when the module is disabled by the SA
ui_bugs.issue: The event row still shows the 'Attiva (incluso)' button and there is no 'module disabled' notice, even though GET /addons/planner returns events[].module_disabled=true. The user is invited to activate a disabled module (and see the backend issue above).

action_items: Add an `if await _disabled(org_id, product): raise 403` guard to addons.activate() and to the /addons/{product}/checkout route (planner and eventmap), the same way controlroom checkout does
EventPlanner/EventMap pages: when events[].module_disabled is true, hide or disable the 'Attiva' / purchase CTAs and show a 'Modulo disattivato dal Super Admin, contatta l'assistenza' banner
critical_code_review_comments: addons.consume_video does not check modules_disabled either. It relies on summary/activations, so a disabled Event Map with existing covered activations could still use up video credits if the generator calls consume_video directly (is_covered is checked elsewhere; verify that the generator path calls is_covered first).
modules_hub._modules runs summary() and one events query for each module on every /org/modules/access call. The sidebar calls this on navigation, so caching or a lighter query would help.
OrgModulesAdmin CrGrant builds its event list from /platform/addons/orgs/{id}.planner.events; if that request fails, the grant list silently shows 'Nessun evento'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11) for the requested endpoints; 1 minor guard gap in addons activate/checkout

test_credentials: Super Admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md works. The test_cr_* users from earlier iterations no longer exist in the DB.
seed_data_creation: TEST_MH orgs/users were created through /auth/register-organization, plus 1 staff membership and 1 event in the UI org. All were deleted by id at the end. In TEST_EventMap Org, the CR grants made by the test were revoked, modules_disabled is [], and there are 0 active CR purchases. The revoked grant rows and audit entries remain as history.
